change_summary: App-only successor to v101.50. Fixes a Mon Espace defect reported by Louis: a highlight made in "Priere avant chaque Heure" never appeared there. The record was saved correctly, resolved correctly through getTargetInfo and was not stale - but the list was sorted by passage label and then cut to the first 8 entries. Labels beginning with a letter ("Priere - ...", "Complement - ...") sort after every "Ne Heure" label, so on his real data the prayer highlight sat 35th of 39 groups and every prayer or complement highlight was structurally unreachable. The list is now ordered newest-first, which also matches the notes list and matches looking for the highlight you just made. The 8-entry cap became a preview with a "Voir mes N surlignages" expander, since it previously hid 31 of his 39 groups with no indication anything was missing; notes had the same silent cap and got the same expander. Corpus unchanged.
